readerEvidence.summary: Fresh same-reader full 38-page original-source transcription: five native whole tasks, 38 printed main parts, full available official keys, six personally opened actual figures; original errors and generic companion gaps explicit. No separate model checker.
sourceGaps: All 38 actual original source page PNGs personally opened and fully read in bounded page windows by this same GPT-6.1 Sol ultra source reader: 10 question pages and 28 repeated-question/complete official-key pages. Five native whole tasks, 38 printed main lettered requests, not the catalogue estimate of 39. Four chronological alternatives and seven nested computational requests in question 5 are retained inside their original whole task. Both Part A Particle in a Box and Part B Nothing, Except Everything stay in the single native His Dark Materials problem.

Complete original instructions, 3.5-hour duration, 260-point allocation, acknowledgements, signature affirmations and both June 25 and June 24 discussion dates retained literally. Neither date is represented as an exam held date. Generic instruction references say a constants table and designated answer sheets will be provided; no such companion is obtainable among the two related catalogue source files. Those generic source gaps remain explicit, with no invented sheets or constants.

All five available official solutions are fully transcribed, including every derivation, numerical substitution, scoring/rubric row, error-carried-forward guidance, alternative method and final tail. Question 3 key retains equations 3–20, full lunar torque/Taylor calculation and original PDF hyperlink annotations. Question 4 key retains both Doppler derivations, full aberration/solid-angle/coordinate method and final celestial-sphere discussion. Question 5 key retains every a–r request, both classical and statistical pressure derivations, full integration by parts, all thermodynamic/cosmological arguments and the final neutrino ratio/scoring.

Source question errors preserved: question 3(h) refers to part (e) although its subsequent calculation uses (f); question 4(f) literally says from the the; question 5 momentum-integration hint prints 4 pi squared dp, while its key uses 4 pi p squared dp. These are source values/wording, without a silent physical correction.

Source key 2 coordinate inconsistencies preserved: printed cosine alpha in its latitude reduction, subsequent beta 49 degrees 42 minutes and lambda 135 degrees 14 minutes, numeric precession denominator cosine 23.44 degrees where the prior symbolic denominator is sine, original alpha-prime 13h32m, rubric longitude 90 degrees, spelling becuse and literal 1 points. No coordinate/physics correction.

Source key 3 refers to Eq.4 for inserting Omega-dot though the printed relevant relation is Eq.5. Source key 4 prints omega-prime as 2 pi divided by lambda without c, reverses its declination/right-ascension direction wording on one page then labels those directions differently on the following page, literally says write rewrite, and retains its printed arctan branch. Every original expression and word remains visible.

Source key 5(c) only says Any response receives full credit; no numerical degeneracy answer invented. Two key 5(m) denominators actually print plus one inside the exponential beta(pc−mu)+1; high-resolution actual original glyph inspection confirms this and both are retained. The final subsequent denominator has plus one outside, as printed. The isolated period before Then the average force and key 5(p) differential relation dV/V=3 da/a=3H without dt are retained.

One source-reader draft misreading T to the fourteenth power was repaired to the actual printed T to the fourth power after personally opening the high-resolution original page-26 glyph. The printed original left crescent Moon symbol was retained with a supported KaTeX character representation after personally opening the original page-10 glyph. These are corrections of this reader draft, not rewritten source errors or a separate checker.

Six retained unique actual original crop resources, two question and four official-key graphics, cover eight printed occurrences including two repeated question figures in the key booklet. All six final 300 dpi PNG bytes were personally opened with original detail, accepted with exact SHA256 and verified public by the canonical figure tool. Original embedded spherical-diagram scan quality is preserved; no redrawing, masks, reconstruction or formula screenshots.

Mechanical wording comparison executes the canonical tool against both trusted original text layers. Raw R1 alerts and actual source-page/annotation proof are retained. The tool comparisons are mechanical gates, not an independent reviewer or an accuracy percentage. Exact original Markdown reference destinations, figure roles and mathematical notation must not be distorted to satisfy false prose alerts.

Genuine fresh automated single-pass receipt identifies this same original source reader. Candidate and final MDX lint/KaTeX, schema/math/source, source-byte, page-image, actual-crop and wording gates are executed. No separate model checker, independent review, 100% accuracy guarantee, rewritten historical reader, receipt override/bypass, or canonical/shared manifest/config/code/state/Git mutation. Root remains sole promoter/publisher.
